_comment: Example config for scripts/build-kit.mjs. Each key replaces the placeholder of the same name in assets/review-kit.tmpl.html. SUPABASE_ANON_KEY is public by design: it only identifies the project. The security policy is what protects the data, since the anonymous role can insert but never read.
_note_label: SECTION_LABEL keeps a trailing space on purpose: the kit builds "Step 1: Title".
